name: Session Guard Concurrency Coordinator
purpose: Coordinates parallel project execution across independent sessions, providing non-blocking queues and mutual exclusion locks for hardware-bound bottlenecks (Chromium render host, Kokoro TTS, Playwright frame-review) on Apple Silicon macOS without compromising rendering quality.
capabilities: Exclusive render host lock: serializes Chromium + Metal GPU rendering and frame-review across concurrent sessions
Exclusive TTS lock: serializes neural speech synthesis to prevent PyTorch resident memory pressure
Stale lock self-healing: detects dead holder PIDs and automatically cleans stale locks
Heartbeat wait logging: informs background sessions of resource lock holders while waiting
Isolated Git worktree management: session-start, session-list, session-end with automated branch isolation and virtualenv linking

installation.instructions: Built-in workspace tool. Run via python3 scripts/session-guard.py <subcommand>.

compatibility.notes: Uses standard library fcntl.flock on POSIX macOS.

security.notes: Writes lockfiles to .locks/ and coordinates local subprocess execution.

approval_evidence: Validated via cross-process concurrency tests and scoped governance checks.
